lines: # Runs when the round of Four Kingdoms ends (the timer's on_end)
execute as @a[scores={msm_examples.four_kingdoms.points=10..}] run tellraw @a [{"selector":"@s"},{"text":" wins the round!","color":"gold"}]

meta.notes: Ends a round, run by the timer when the time is up: names the players with 10 or more defeats and rebuilds the arena. Run msm_examples:four_kingdoms/start again for the next round.
